name: @lumithink/a2a-server
description: P1-01 (issue #83) standalone LumiThink A2A validation service skeleton: official @a2a-js/sdk server, Agent Card, JSON-RPC over HTTPS + SSE, standard error mapping, Task-only business adapter and the Task Manager / Task Store boundary. Loopback-only (127.0.0.1), validation port 3312 reserved by deploy/validation. SYNTHETIC executor only — a protocol-transport pass does NOT mark the real DSH execution gate (P1-10/#92) as passed.
